about: The wild boar's run: four poses of the body's own Run (a short, heavy four-beat rotary gallop keyed on the leg targets in boar_pass.py: hind left, hind right, fore right, fore left; the body near its standing height with little bounce and the fore hooves reaching ahead before they land), judged at the run of 95 ms a tile (`walk_step_ms` over `gait.run_div`): FLEE runs at it now (HUNTING.md section 2), and DEFEND's charge in a line will once the fight exists.
